input.summary: Add mutual successor-assignment carve-out with written notice to the nonassignability clause.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have added the standard successor carve-out so either party may assign to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets on written notice, while all other assignments continue to require consent that is not unreasonably withheld. This is our fallback assignment position.

ops.oldText: Neither party shall assign, transfer, or subcontract this Agreement or any of its obligations hereunder without the other party's express, prior written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld.
ops.newText: Except that either party may assign this Agreement to a successor in a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets upon written notice to the other party, neither party shall assign, transfer, or subcontract this Agreement or any of its obligations hereunder without the other party's express, prior written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld.
